text: Free Titanic demo on Steam, and you own the ship.
The developer calls itself White Star Line. The company that owned the real one.
Is it any good? Here's the honest version.
Pick a route on the world map, buy coal, sell tickets, haul cargo.
Southampton to New York is on there. So are Egypt and Australia.
Best part: first person. Walk up to the bridge, and it feels like your ship.
The catch? In the trailer, the passengers stand perfectly still. Like mannequins.
We checked the file list. Almost the whole demo is one file, nearly two and a half gigs.
Think Ship Simulator crossed with a shipping tycoon.
Worth a dip if you've always wanted the Titanic to make it.
